proposition: The Majlis 10196 colophons place copies of the Asrār al-Ṣalāt and the R. Ḥurūf in Yazd (Ramaḍān and Dhū l-Qaʿda 828), the Iʿtiqādāt and Nafsat al-Maṣdūr I in Herat (Jumādā I and Rajab 829), the Mabdaʾ u Maʿād at Manzil-i Chālū in Mazandaran (Ṣafar 832) and the K. al-Manāhij in Natanz (Rajab 833): these are places of copying, which Melvin-Koushki takes as places of composition only for the second half.
